description: Conversion of flat into two self-contained flats (Class C3) (1 x 2 beds & 1 x 3 beds); cycle storage
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;Design and Access Statement, Further details from agent 16/01/2026, Reasonable Exception Statement, 1195.54 – 001, 1195.54 – 010, 1195.54 – 020, 1195.54 – 030, 1195.54 – 100, 1195.54 – 200, 1195.54 – 300, 1195.54 – 600.

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, full details of the external appearance of the bin stores shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The bin stores shall be made available prior to occupation and shall be retained thereafter. The refuse bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, in the designated refuse storage area, as shown on the approved drawing.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Evidence of certification of Secure by Design Accreditation for the development shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval before any part of the development is occupied or used. The development shall only be completed and operated in accordance with any approval.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The development hereby approved shall be built in accordance with the Noise Insultation details submitted (Ref. Further Details from Agent 16/01/2026) and retained thereafter.</p>
<p>The development hereby approved shall not commence until an Emergency Evacuation Plan is submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall not be occupied until a Car Parking Management Plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the plan approved and retained thereafter.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the commencement of the relevant part of works of the development hereby permitted, full details of authority the location of a secure and sheltered cycle store, including the dimensions and external finish of the store shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The cycle storage shall be made available prior to occupation of the development and shall be retained thereafter.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and reenacting that order with or without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Class L in Part 3 and of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved, a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:&nbsp;</p><p>1) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly</p><p>point&nbsp;</p><p>2) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures&nbsp;</p><p>3) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread&nbsp;</p><p>4) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users&nbsp;</p><p>5) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in&nbsp;</p><p>6) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p>
